ModMetaData.description:
Supports Windows Steam 1.6.4871 rev590 and native Linux / Steam Deck 1.6.4871 rev600, including OpenGL texture processing and PNG caching alongside Loading Progress. Both platforms passed live startup, normal exit and texture-output checks. No extra launch flag is required. PNG caching is opt-in and its first cache build can slow loading. These checks do not establish every mod combination or gameplay/save-load behavior. Settings changes require restart. Unsupported game/mod versions keep ordinary behavior. Do not enable alongside another copy of Wake-Up or the old validation package.
